title: "Module 6: Spark Structured APIs"

## Overview

Data wrangling with Spark's structured APIs. The module describes the household dataset used in the exercises, then covers creating DataFrames, defining schemas, and common DataFrame transformations.

## Common error: Java version
Spark notebooks fail with `UnsupportedClassVersionError` or `Java gateway process exited` when Java is
missing or too old. PySpark 4 needs **Java 17 or later**. See
[PySpark setup → Troubleshooting](../../pyspark-setup.qmd#troubleshooting).
:::
